messages:
maria: FYI seeing an egress spike on rack r12-az3, started ~16:04 UTC. Tail latency up and packet drops on the top-of-rack. Looks correlated with a few tenants in fractional/dedicated slices.
lee: I have the graphs. 95th egress latency from r12 -> internet jumped from 12ms -> 180ms. Dropped packets up to 4%.
anika: which tenants? can we just drain the offending pods? it's a dedicated slice right?
maria: brightai and an internal perf-test job. brightai is long-lived, fractional-dedicated so we can't simply evict without service impact. perf-test is ephemeral, draining that helps but not enough.
lee: short-term mitigation: apply NIC shaping for tenant MACs and move perf-test off the rack. Longer term: consider soft-isolation per-tenant egress quotas on the slice.
jonathan: quick check on cost: if we shift brightai to another AZ we might incur cross-AZ/region egress charges (they're serving content to customers). any estimate?
maria: moving within same region -> minimal. cross-region would be non-trivial. prefer warm-pool fallback in same region first.
sre-bot: alert: egress-surge r12-az3 severity=high tenants=[brightai, perf-test] detected at 2026-03-20T16:04:12Z
lee: I'm going to try a conservative tc qdisc cap on the tenant veth to protect the rack. If that drops app-level throughput too much we'll rollback.
lee: Command I'll run (one-liner):
```
# cap to 500mbit burstable
sudo tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 500mbit burst 32kb latency 50ms
```
maria: do it, but coordinate with deploy-bot drain if you need to move pods.
deploy-bot: scheduled drain: host r12-az3 at 2026-03-20T16:05:40Z by maria - includes perf-test namespace only
anika: I'll kick off a 10% canary routing change for brightai to route to eu-west-warm-pool (same region preferred) — this will test fallback without full migration.
jonathan: careful: eu-west warm pool is same region? if not, annotate cost impact before we route production.
anika: it's same region eu-west-2, so cost delta is small. will tag the rollout with cost-note.
lee: monitor kv cache miss rate for brightai after routing change. If miss_rate > 12% or latency > 200ms, abort.
maria: creating a runbook stub and ticket: infra-ops/egress-drain-2945617890. Will include rollback steps and cost calc.
jonathan: can we also add an alert tweak so the incident bot pages infra after 3 repeated egress spikes in 10m? current threshold only pages on node loss.
sre-bot: alert rule update proposal created: rule-id=egress-repeat-3in10m by maria
maria: thanks. follow-up: we should evaluate tenant-level soft quotas + per-slice shaping in next retro. Cost tradeoffs + SLOs needed.
anika: agree. I'll put it on infra backlog and draft a PoC for per-tenant egress shaping using eBPF.
lee: monitoring note: post-cap 16:06 -> packet drops down to 0.8% and latency 95th -> 40ms. perf-test drain removed ~18% of egress load.
maria: good progress. I'll keep the canary at 10% for 30m, then scale to 30% if stable.
jonathan: thanks all. please add cost estimate once canary completes. :thumbsup:
